content: Real attendance products layer three independent signals: live camera capture (face), GPS radius check, and a server-generated timestamp (never trust device clock). Liveness detection (active: prompt gesture; passive: analyze micro-movement/depth/reflection cues) is what actually defeats 'photo of a photo' or screen-replay attacks — a bare selfie without liveness is trivially spoofed. Combining GPS spoofing resistance with liveness makes double-spoofing materially harder even though neither alone is sufficient.
